'''Jahan Hold''' is a hold of the [[Broken Cliff]] sept of the [[Daryne]] [[Aiel]]. It is the hold of [[Clan chief]] [[Mandelain]] and his wives [[Jair]] (roofmistress) and [[Corehuin]]. It's [[Wise One]] is [[Merale]]. It is only mentioned in [[The Wheel of Time Companion]].
